# What's new in Power Apps

Resources to learn about new features recently released, features releasing over the next few months, and known limitations.

## Weekly releases

For new features, fixes, and improvements, see Released versions for Microsoft Power Apps.

## Release plan

See Release Planner (releaseplans.microsoft.com).

## Monthly releases for model-driven apps

| Channel | Frequency | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Semi-annual | Twice per year | Rollout starts early April and early October. Default. |
| Monthly | Once per month | Rollout follows weekly release schedule starting with the first weekly release for the month. |

## Known limitations

See Common issues and resolutions.
